items.title: The AI-Powered Financial Institution
items.coreQuestion: Where is AI creating real competitive advantage in financial services, and what is still hype?
items.lane: AI in financial products, customer relationships, operations, risk and regulation. Security controls and AI governance sit with AI Security & Governance.

items.title: Building an AI-Ready State
items.coreQuestion: How do governments move from AI strategy to AI-powered public services and economic value at scale?
items.lane: AI adoption in government and public services: citizen services, government productivity, public-sector data and procurement. National compute and sovereign models sit with AI Infrastructure & Sovereign AI; AI regulation and policy sit with AI Security & Governance.

items.title: The AI-Powered Finance Function
items.coreQuestion: How is AI changing forecasting, close, controls and capital allocation, and where is it delivering return finance can measure?
items.lane: AI inside the corporate finance function: planning and forecasting, the close, controls and assurance, treasury and capital allocation. Data protection and model governance sit with Sovereign AI & Security.
themes: AI in planning, budgeting and forecasting
A faster close and continuous reporting
Finance data quality and systems readiness

items.title: Winning Customers, Not Just Content
items.coreQuestion: Where is AI changing how brands win customers, and where is it just producing more content?
items.lane: AI in customer acquisition, brand and marketing operations: personalisation, creative production, media buying and measurement. Customer data protection and consent sit with Sovereign AI & Security.
themes: AI in creative production and brand voice
Being found in AI answers, not just search
In-house capability versus the agency model

items.title: Owning and Securing Qatar's AI
items.coreQuestion: What must Qatar own, secure and govern before AI runs on sensitive data and national systems?
items.lane: What the country and its institutions must own and control — sovereign compute, data residency, Arabic and national models — together with the security, governance and assurance required before AI touches sensitive data, systems and decisions.
themes: Sovereign compute, data centres and power
Identity and permissions for AI agents
Data leakage, privacy and third-party AI risk
AI-enabled cyber defence and incident response
Assurance, audit and model risk management

items.title: From Pilot to Patient
items.coreQuestion: Where is AI improving patient outcomes and clinical capacity today, and what stops it scaling safely across a health system?
items.lane: AI in clinical care, hospital operations, life sciences and health insurance. Health-data security sits with AI Security & Governance.
participantProfile: Chief medical information officer / clinical informatics lead
Hospital chief operating or nursing officer
